title: U.S. Strikes on Alleged Drug Boats Could Be Criminal, U.N. Expert Says
summary_full: A U.N. human rights investigator, like other experts, concluded that the Trump administration’s deadly attacks violate international law, and said the strikes could be crimes against humanity.
